title: Separate critical event ingestion from polling
body: MIRA uses an asynchronous webhook lane for events where near-real-time processing matters, while non-critical state is obtained through polling. The webhook endpoint accepts the event and processing occurs asynchronously.

attributes.statement: Critical events enter MIRA through an asynchronous webhook lane, while non-critical state continues to use polling.
attributes.rationale: Not every state transition requires immediate processing. A dedicated critical lane provides timely handling where necessary without turning the entire ingestion architecture into a push-dependent system.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Use synchronous processing for every incoming event
alternatives_rejected.reason: Would couple external event delivery to MIRA processing latency and reliability.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Use push events for all LMS state
alternatives_rejected.reason: Conflicts with the heterogeneous fleet and the decision to keep LMS ingestion independent of brand integrations.
